chain.title: Green as a Subway Car
chain.desc: One of Create's iron sheets and a green dye, shapeless. The metro casing is the base block the whole underground-railway set is built from.

chain.title: Panelling the Carriage
chain.desc: Three metro casings in a row give the flat panel; it converts freely back and forth with its corrugated twin.

chain.title: Ribbed for Strength
chain.desc: A metro casing crafted alone flips to the corrugated finish, and crafting it again flips it back.

chain.title: A View From the Tunnel
chain.desc: A metro casing and any glass, shapeless. Rolling stock stops looking like a box the moment it has windows.

chain.title: Hatches in the Floor
chain.desc: Two metro casings stacked. The trapdoor matches the casing texture, so a carriage floor stays continuous.

chain.title: Cutting Through the Dark
chain.desc: A torch tucked into a column of three iron nuggets. Mounted on the nose of a train it throws light down the track ahead.

chain.title: Somewhere to Wait
chain.desc: Smooth stone and a smooth stone slab, shapeless, or one cut of smooth stone on a stonecutter. The edging that turns a station into a platform.

chain.title: Mind the Gap
chain.desc: Five andesite alloy in a stepped shape. Steps hang off the side of a bogie so a passenger can actually climb aboard.

chain.title: Something to Hold
chain.desc: Six andesite alloy in two columns. Grab bars line a carriage interior and read as handholds rather than fence posts.

chain.title: The Last Step Down
chain.desc: Three andesite alloy in a row, or one alloy on the stonecutter. It sits under a doorway where the carriage meets the platform.

chain.title: The Cowcatcher
chain.desc: Create iron sheets and iron nuggets in a wedge. Pilots bolt onto the front of a locomotive and are the mod's signature piece.

chain.title: A Pilot in Brass
chain.desc: The same wedge built from Create brass sheets and brass nuggets, for engines that want gold trim instead of grey.

chain.title: Two Windows Make a Hatch
chain.desc: Two of Create's ornate iron windows crafted together. It finishes the ornate iron family Create left without a trapdoor.

notes: Verified against bellsandwhistles-0.4.5-1.20.x-Create6.0+.jar (Forge/NeoForge, MC 1.20.1). All 36 ids come from assets/bellsandwhistles/models/item/*.json intersected with block./item. keys in assets/bellsandwhistles/lang/en_us.json. PARENT ASSUMPTIONS: the chain starts after Create has supplied andesite alloy, create:iron_sheet, create:brass_sheet, create:copper_sheet, brass and copper nuggets, create:ornate_iron_window, and the whole polished_cut_* family of Create decorative stones (asurine, calcite, crimsite, deepslate, diorite, dripstone, granite, limestone, ochrum, scorchia, scoria, tuff, veridium) along with their stairs, since every stone pilot is built from a polished cut block plus its matching stairs. This is a decoration addon for trains, so the spine is casings and mountable parts rather than machines. Recipe sources read: data/bellsandwhistles/recipes/*.json. Confirmed conversions: metro_casing comes only from create:iron_sheet plus minecraft:green_dye, corrugated_metro_casing is a one-item shapeless flip of the metro casing, and metro_panel and corrugated_metro_panel each convert into the other. Metal parts (bogie steps, grab rails, door steps) exist in andesite, brass and copper and each has both a crafting recipe and a stonecutting shortcut from the ingot; the andesite versions use create:andesite_alloy directly. bellsandwhistles:polished_andesite_pilot and polished_deepslate_pilot, polished_diorite_pilot and polished_granite_pilot each have two recipes, one from vanilla polished stone and one from Create's polished cut version. No id was dropped for being unverifiable. Deliberately unquested: nothing in this jar trips the slab/stairs/wall rule, and every remaining item appears either in the chain or in a collection.
